subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should the canonical safety contract cap model tool-calling rounds only, or also expose total tool-call and timeout-after-first-tool limits?
rationale: The proof-positive candidate intentionally implements a round circuit breaker, while this issue proposes three different counters and timers whose exhaustion behavior affects channels and harnesses differently.

options.title: Round budget first
options.body: Land the candidate's opt-in per-round limit and track total-call or timeout controls as separate follow-ups.

options.title: Broaden this contract
options.body: Require total tool-call and post-first-tool timeout semantics before considering this issue solved.

options.title: Keep current controls
options.body: Decline a new hard-budget config surface and retain loop detection plus whole-run timeout.

recommendation.title: Round budget first
recommendation.body: Land the candidate's opt-in per-round limit and track total-call or timeout controls as separate follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: She owns the current candidate follow-up and its cross-harness behavior and proof.
